header.label: projects
header.title: Optimal Placement of Absorbing Material in a Concert Hall
header.lede: How to spread a limited amount of sound-absorbing material over the walls of a concert hall so that it soaks up as much sound as possible: a wave model, an adjoint gradient and a pre-fractal wall answer it.
